title: Five-point coral bleaching reports gave no clear common heat link in four Atlantic and Pacific samples in 2003-2019
abstract: We tested five-point grid membership in 1,194 Reef Check bleaching reports from 5% to 95%. Four Atlantic and Pacific samples cover 2003-2010 and 2011-2019. Models controlled country, year, month, depth and reported severity bands. Grid shares were 22-56%. Heat slopes were +9.91, -13.16, -5.02 and -2.93 percentage points per four TSA degree-heating weeks. All four primary country-grouped intervals included zero after correction for four tests. Sensitivity results did not show a stable common link. Grid membership cannot establish rounding error. Selected reports, conditioning on severity, few country groups and limited heat support prevent causal or equality claims. The package gives code, source hashes, aggregate results, a figure and checks. Source records remain external.

display.caption: Grid shares and heat slopes. Country-grouped intervals are adjusted for four primary tests; all include zero.
